cohort: 311 women in Rwanda recruited from four different health centers during their late second trimester of pregnancy or later
finding: Postnatal depressive symptoms were present in one in five Rwandan women, with poor maternal social support, particularly poor partner support, significantly increasing the risk, while good friend support acted as a protector.
mod_finding: The abstract does not provide specific findings related to mode of delivery.
gest_age: Late second trimester or later at baseline
